env.name: SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET
env.description: Verifies the HMAC signature on every Slack request

env.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
env.description: Slack bot token for views.open and file sharing

env.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
env.description: Google Cloud project for Pub/Sub and telemetry

env.name: PUBSUB_PROJECT
env.description: Pub/Sub project for the job topic, when it differs from GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT

env.name: PUBSUB_TOPIC
env.description: Pub/Sub topic that receives emoji-generation jobs

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI key; used by the worker for prompt enhancement and image generation

env.name: OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL
env.description: OpenAI text model used for prompt enhancement

env.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
env.description: Gemini key; enables the Google image provider

env.name: ENVIRONMENT
env.description: Deployment environment name for logs and telemetry

env.name: TRACING_ENABLED
env.description: Turns Cloud Trace export on or off

env.name: METRICS_ENABLED
env.description: Turns Cloud Monitoring metrics on or off

env.name: K_SERVICE
env.description: Set by Cloud Run; identifies the running service
